newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Choong Wae says develops hepatitis drug.
newsitem.headline: Choong Wae says develops hepatitis drug.

text.p: South Korea's Choong Wae Pharmacy Co Ltd said on Monday it had developed a treatment for Hepatitis-B, and would begin human testing this week.
In a statement, the company said it had spent five billion won on the development of the NP-77A treatment over the past five years.
Once testing is successfully completed, the company plans to market the treatment internationally by the year 2000, it said.
Choong Wae shares were flat at 42,600 in active trading at midday on Monday. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5644
